name: Live Platform Motion Ad
description: Square 1:1 silent feed ad for a live-streaming / always-on platform, built in HyperFrames as ONE composition with opacity-gated scene divs and a single paused GSAP timeline. Five beats carry the 'something is happening RIGHT NOW' energy: a glitch-reveal brand wordmark with a pulsing LIVE-red dot, a 6-tile stream WALL of real muted <video> clips (not static thumbnails) whose viewer counts tick up from zero, a single tile expanding to full-bleed with a faux chat-firehose scrolling up the rail, a marquee of category pills sweeping across a brand-gradient wash, and a wordmark slam + CTA end-slate. The register is broadcast-functional, NOT bouncy — snappy motion, flat tier shifts, colored glow instead of drop shadows, the LIVE-red dot on screen in every beat as the silent 'watch now' cue. Two load-bearing details: stream tiles are real <video> tags pulled fresh from the platform (audio stripped at preprocess), and the brand glyph is built from its OWN multi-layer SVG (white interior + compound fill-rule=evenodd frame + eye bars), never reconstructed from memory. $0 model spend. Silent by design (FB feed auto-mutes).
referenceNotes: No AI-gen refs. Supply the brand's official logo SVG (multi-layer) + N real platform clip URLs to pull. The platform's own UI is the reference — pull its real tokens, fonts, and clips.

slots.description: The platform site to ground tokens + fonts against.
The official multi-layer brand glyph SVG (white interior + compound fill-rule=evenodd frame + eye bars). Required — never reconstruct from memory.
Brand HEX (primary brand color, void bg, surface tiers, LIVE-red), pulled from the site.
N real platform clip URLs to pull for the stream-wall tiles (audio stripped at preprocess).
Per-beat all-caps caption hooks (display font), ≥1.6s each on screen.
Category pills for the marquee beat (Games / IRL / Music / ...).

doNotCopyLiterally: Ask for the brand SVG BEFORE Beat 0 — never reconstruct a branded glyph from memory; copy its layer structure (white fill + compound fill-rule=evenodd frame + eye bars), not just one path. Default the stream-wall to real muted
stackSummary: No model calls. yt-dlp to pull N platform clips (audio stripped via ffmpeg -an), HyperFrames single composition (opacity-gated scenes, real <video> tiles, GSAP timeline on window.__timelines), ralphy render for the 1080x1080 silent mp4. $0 total.
